newsitem.title: UK: Tesco creates 300 jobs at bank call centre.
newsitem.headline: Tesco creates 300 jobs at bank call centre.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said it was recruiting 300 people for a new telephone call centre in Glasgow, Scotland, to provide support for its joint venture with Royal Bank of Scotland, Tesco Personal Finance.
In a statement, the company said the call centre would open in July and be operational 24-hours a day.

Tesco announced its joint venture with Royal Bank in February for financial services. The venture will launch a credit card over the summer and takes over Tesco's interest-paying ClubCard Plus account.
Tesco already has a customer service centre in Dundee which was opened just over a year ago and employs 250 people.
Royal Bank operates a number of call centres in Glasgow covering Direct Line insurance and financial services as well as Royal Bank's direct banking. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
